name: Emanoil Wants to Be Bitten
summary: A Vallaki clerk who sleeps in a coffin writes long poems to the castle and wants to be chosen by the lord of the valley.

stages.journal: Emanoil, a clerk in black he can't afford, writes bad poems to the castle and sleeps in a coffin from Henrik's, because he wants to be chosen and bitten. He asked if we were from the castle, and was disappointed.
objectives: Help Emanoil, or talk him out of it
stages.hint: Talk to Emanoil outside Henrik's coffin shop in Vallaki, by day.

stages.journal: Emanoil is a little less alone than he was. Whatever we did, he will remember that someone asked what he wanted, and the next poem is about us.
